params.description:
List organizations with names containing the value provided. This is
a case insensitive match.

Get an organization. Accepts both company-scoped tokens and partner
tokens (obtained via `POST /v0/token` with the respective
credentials). The organization must be one the caller has access to —
for partners, one they created via `POST /v2/organizations` or were
granted access to. Useful for verifying an existing organization
before creating companies under it.

info.name: List users attached to an organization

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the user. This is a case-insensitive match.

params.name: name_contains
params.description:
The name of the user contains the value specified. This is a
case-insensitive match.

params.name: email
params.description: The user has the email address. This is a case-insensitive match.

params.name: email_contains
params.description:
The email of the user contains the value specified. This is a
case-insensitive match.

items.docs: List users attached to an organization.

info.name: Create and attach user to an organization

items.docs:
Create and attach a user to an organization. If the user already exists,
use the `attachUserToOrganizationV2` (`POST /v2/organizations/{organization_id}/users/attach`)
operation instead.

info.name: Attach an existing user to an organization

items.docs:
Attaches an existing user to an organization. You may provide the
`user_id` or `email`. If the user does not exist, you will need to use
the `createOrganizationUserV2` operation.

Removes the user from the organization. **NOTE**: This will remove the
user from __ALL__ of the companies within the organization.
